messages:
Maya L.: quick preflight for ProofTrack POC — enterprise trial kicks Mon 2026-03-23. Need final owners and any blocking deps. Staging network ready? SSO? model pinned? success criteria? sched?

Eli K.: I can own infra + staging. Staging cluster is up but need CIDR open for ProofTrack corp VPN. I'll open a ticket with infra-corp. PR for network rules: #1248. ETA: Thu EOD.

Anya S.: SE here. I'll own integration deliverables (sample webhook, auth flow, uptime checks). Success criteria: 95% valid responses on sample eval set, end-to-end latency < 400ms p95 for 512 tokens. Can we confirm model variant & quantization?

Josh R.: I'll run the eval sets and monitor regressions. Recommend `redwood/opt-1.3-8bit` (or `opt-1.3q` if available). Need permission to run canary at 10qps for 2 hours.

Eli K.: CIDR to allow: 
```
10.12.34.0/24
172.20.0.0/16
```
PR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/prooftrack/pulls/1248

Infra Bot: deploy/prooftrack-staging succeeded — nodes 3/3 ready. image: rwinf/staging:20260318-rc3

Maya L.: thanks. @Josh R. pls comment PR #1248 with canary window. Also Anya pls post final success metric doc in drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sales/prooftrack/poc-success.md

Anya S.: posted. Also note: customer requires KMS integration and audit logs retained 90d. Is Private option needed?

Eli K.: KMS fine via AWS KMS key `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/prooftrack`. Audit logs will be pushed to customer S3 bucket. Might need Private if they require VPC peering.

Josh R.: Quick code-review ping: PR #1302 adds eval harness; @maya or @anya can you do a quick review? small changes.

Maya L.: reviewing now. minor nit on test names. :thumbsup:

Anya S.: reviewed, left one comment re: webhook retry logic. :eyes:

Maya L.: can we cutover canary Mon 10:00 PT? If infra + SE confirm, I'll coordinate with Sales ops.

Eli K.: confirm 10:00 PT works. I'll enable canary 09:45 and monitor.

Infra Bot: scheduled canary: 2026-03-23T10:00:00-07:00 (user=Eli K.)

Josh R.: I'll run eval at canary start, posting results in this thread.

Maya L.: perfect. One last ask — owners list:

- Infra: Eli K.
- SE: Anya S.
- Eval: Josh R.
- PM: Maya L.

Confirm here or escalate by EOD Fri.

Anya S.: confirmed. :white_check_mark:

Eli K.: confirmed. :white_check_mark:

Josh R.: confirmed. :white_check_mark:

Maya L.: thanks team. I'll create rollout ticket and post final cutover playbook.
